name: com.vegetaalpha.pool
description: Framework-agnostic object pooling: Register/GetObj/ReleaseObj/DestroyPool over any ISpawner. No dependencies — use the static Pool facade or construct/inject your own PoolSystem. Prefabs are supplied by you: SO_AllPoolData is included and works out of the box, or call Register() with a prefab from anywhere (Addressables, Resources, a factory). Import a sample for a runnable demo scene.
